en_us: A large village keeps its guards, villagers and cats over all its area: units at the edge of a city belong to the village and hear its alerts. The territory of each tier contains its village.
fr_fr: Un grand village garde ses gardes, villageois et chats sur toute sa surface : les unités au bord d'une cité appartiennent au village et entendent ses alertes. Le territoire de chaque palier contient son village.
